anomalies.observed: The LDO output is on net +3.3V, while net +3V3 has no regulator source. Every main MCU VDD pin is placed in an unconnected-(...VDD...) net rather than on +3.3V or +3V3.

anomalies.impact: The FCC and NAVC MCUs receive no main supply; the board cannot boot or operate.

anomalies.observed: The sensor I2C SCL/SDA nets NET0038 and NET0040 connect the magnetometer, temperature sensor, EEPROM, IMU, barometer, pull-up resistors and test points, but contain no NAVC2 pins. NAVC2 is otherwise disconnected from the navigation peripherals and from FCC2.

anomalies.observed: No otter_CH330 or equivalent USB-to-UART bridge component appears anywhere in the netlist. The USB2 and USB6 D+/D- pins are left on unconnected nets.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists two otter_CH330 USB-to-UART converters in the Connections sheet for programming/debug UART-to-USB interfaces.
anomalies.impact: The board lacks the intended USB-to-UART programming/debug bridges, so those UART-to-USB interfaces are absent or nonfunctional.
